information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits the incumbent-style negative-authority analysis. The second call consumes only that analysis and projects it to binding exclusions by removing predecessor-authored nonbinding material. The final call consumes the projected analysis, directly receives every common input, honors the exclusions, and emits one complete policy.
name: Exclusion-Only Projection Aperture
organization: three-call sequential lineage with one authority-preserving lossy visibility transformation

calls.objective: Reconcile visible evidence with normative obligations, identify unsupported commitments as binding exclusions, and preserve admissible conflicts in one analysis without constructing a policy.

Consume establish_admissibility_boundary, retain its binding exclusions, remove its nonbinding affirmative framing and conflict resolutions from lineage-visible state, add no evidence, and emit the projected analysis.
Consume project_boundary_polarity, directly examine all common evidence, honor the projected binding exclusions, independently reconcile admissible claims, and emit one complete policy.
